content.comment_body: Hello [user_name], My computer settings: IP: XX.175.113.14 Subnet: 255.255.255.0 Gateway: XX.175.113.1 Details for the [product_name] PLC: IP: XX.175.100.195 Subnet: 255.255.255.0 Gateway: XX.175.100.1 Note: 'XX' is the same for both the PLC and PC. Because of limitations in my process plant, I can't set both devices to the same subnet. The PLC responds to pings from my PC, but when I try to go online, I get the following message: "The IP addresses of your PC and the target [product_name] are not in the same subnet. [product_name] Soft will attempt to add an additional local IP address. Do you want to continue?" Even after assigning an additional IP address, communication is unsuccessful. Could you please advise? Note: Setting both the PC and [product_name] PLC on the same subnet is not an option due to plant requirements. --- This was separated from the discussion about PC and [product_name] not being on the same subnet.

I'm unable to provide a solution here. The [product_name] and the computer must be on the same subnet, as indicated by the error message. Additionally, the gateway addresses differ. You should consult your IT department to determine if it's possible for the [product_name] to be assigned an IP address within the PC's subnet.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter network issues preventing their computer from connecting to a [product_name] PLC because process constraints require different subnets. Software suggestions to add an additional local IP address do not result in successful communication.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates being able to connect and access the [product_name] PLC from their computer without needing both devices on the same subnet, owing to limitations in the process setup.
